items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
Experience planning the logistics of trainings, events and conferences.

Project management experience to include defining goals, organizing and scheduling complex projects, coordinating project execution and managing teams. Analytical skills to identify issues, compare data and develop goals or plans for resolution and implementation. Experience developing, analyzing and implementing a budget.
Experience in marketing, outreach and communications. Experience drafting, editing and producing correspondence, reports, fliers, forms and presentations.

Experience in using databases. Experience using computerized financial systems to prepare financial reports and forms. Experience in MS Office in a Windows environment to use electronic mail, Internet, Microsoft Office, database systems and spreadsheets.

Experience working in a team and establishing relationships with people from diverse backgrounds including staff, faculty and agency clients. Interpersonal, oral and written communication skills to interact professionally and effectively in person, on the telephone, online and via email.

Under the direct supervision of the Supervisor, the Program Coordinator will support the CalWORKs program by planning, organizing, and delivering programs that strengthen Wraparound practice statewide. This position is responsible for the implementation of continuing education courses for Human Services, and supporting special projects related to workforce development. The incumbent will plan events, such as conferences, symposiums, convenings and meetings. This role provides overall management for contract-related and county-specific projects, including fiscal responsibility of the program and overseeing instructor compensation, facilities and catering. They will establish and adhere to project procedures to guarantee completion of contract goals.

This position provides quality customer service, assist with the development of new projects, assist with administrative team projects, participate in/attend unit and department-wide meetings and committees. Provide onsite and virtual support for trainings, institutes, conferences, and special programs. Assist with compiling program data and creating reports ensuring high-quality standards for workforce development within the Wraparound model.

This position has a Hybrid Remote work schedule with the expectation of 1 in-office day each week, with additional on-site days as needed to meet business needs. The main on-site work location will be the International Center located in Davis, CA, with occasional meetings at Aggie Square located in Sacramento, CA.
Organizational and time management skills to manage, track, and work on multiple and simultaneous complex tasks.
Knowledge of the field of human services.
